message:
Update README for launch features

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Accessibility pass

- text colors raised to WCAG AA contrast in light and dark mode
- sheets: focus moves in, Tab is trapped, Escape closes, focus returns
- 'Skip to content' link; chat log and deal results announced to screen readers
- reveal progress spoken ('Company 2 of 5'); glossary terms announce they open a dialog

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add classroom mode

- teachers create a class and get a 6-letter code; students join with the code
  and a first name and all play the same five companies (fixed at creation)
- finished days are recorded per class (once per game)
- teacher dashboard (token kept on the teacher's device): live results, how the
  class invested in each company, and discussion prompts generated from the data
- 'Classroom' in the nav and 'Join a class' on home
- Supabase client now loads on demand (main bundle 503 KB -> 290 KB)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add royalty deals

- offers can add a royalty: sales repay up to 1x over ~3 years (less if the
  company dies early); founders value royalty offers 25% lower
- the Cash Flow Hawk offers royalties (Doorbot, Bantam Bagels, QBall)
- UI: royalty switch on the offer card, '+ royalty' on offers and counters,
  payback shown on the reveal; glossary entry explains the game's model

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add achievements and daily-challenge streaks

Nine badges (first deal, 10x, 100x, diversified, survived a flop, number
cruncher, 3- and 7-day streaks, veteran) on the portfolio page; the daily
streak also shows on the home screen.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add a quick valuation check after every deal you win

Three answer choices, instant feedback with the math ($X ÷ Y% = $V);
answers are counted locally for achievements.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add 'Why this company?' reasons and show which ones pay off

- optional reason chip on each offer: Team / Product / Price / Gut feeling
- saved with the deal (game state, Supabase game_deals.reason)
- reveal shows why you invested; portfolio shows profit by reason
  ('What works for you')

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add a shareable day result (Wordle-style)

'Share' on the day summary: Tank Day #N ☀️ / 🟩🟥⬜… +$X, via the native share
sheet or the clipboard. Green = your deal made money, red = lost, white = no deal.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

CI: build and smoke-test the API Docker image

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add deployment setup: Docker, Fly/Render/Vercel configs, Sentry, Plausible

- root Dockerfile for the API (uv, non-root user, health check, proxy headers)
- fly.toml and render.yaml (pick one), frontend/vercel.json
- optional Sentry (SENTRY_DSN) on the API and Plausible (VITE_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN) on the web app
- docs/DEPLOY.md: Supabase dashboard steps, env vars, deploy commands, checks

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add privacy and terms pages and a 13+ check for accounts

- plain-language Privacy and Terms screens linked from the footer
  (guest play at any age; accounts require 13+; how to delete an account)
- sign-in form requires confirming age 13 or older
- VITE_CONTACT_EMAIL for the contact link

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add CI and a weekly YouTube embed check

- GitHub Actions CI: ruff, pytest, content validation, frontend lint + build
- scripts/check_embeds.py (+ weekly workflow, 'make embeds'): flags clips that
  were removed or had embedding disabled

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Rebalance: 6 more pitches and 2-3 failed companies every day

- new: Rolodoc, Beulr, OatMeals (failed); Trippie (break-even/small loss);
  QBall (small win); Cycloramic (pivot, sold to Carvana)
- pool is now 23 pitches, 10 of which failed
- each day now includes 2-3 failures; 'buy everything' now loses ~16% of days
- new 'pivot' lesson

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add per-IP rate limits and a daily cap on paid AI calls

- new games 30/hour, founder questions 60/hour, offers 120/min per IP (429 otherwise)
- AI founder answers capped per UTC day (AI_DAILY_CALL_CAP); then offline answers
- TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS for correct client IPs behind a proxy

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Persist game sessions in a database (SQLite locally, Supabase Postgres in prod)

Games now survive restarts and work across multiple server instances.
DATABASE_URL selects the backend; tables are created automatically, and a
Supabase migration adds them with RLS enabled (backend-only access).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Cut excess text everywhere and add a finance glossary

Less text:
- home: one-line tagline, step tiles are icon + word, no footnotes
- game: no repeated counters/captions; facts are bullets only; chat has no
  empty-state copy; shark cards show name, quote, offer
- offer card: one 'Valuation $X · asked $Y' line with a short hint
- result card: icon, title, one line, one button
- reveal: headline, money, lesson; story/sources fold under 'What happened'
- summary/portfolio: short lines; lessons trimmed to one sentence

Glossary:
- 'Learn' page: ~25 money words in three groups, searchable, with examples
- tappable terms in context (ask, valuation, equity, counteroffer, multiple,
  dilution, index fund, diversify) open a definition sheet with a link to all words

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Redesign the whole app with an Apple-style look and a simpler flow

- new design system: system font (SF on Mac), light + automatic dark mode,
  soft cards, pill buttons, segmented controls, custom sliders, gentle motion
- home: one hero, Play / Daily challenge, portfolio shortcut; sharks and
  glossary moved out of the way (glossary + sign-in are now sheets in the nav)
- game: 3 steps (Pitch, Ask, Invest) with a segmented control; the ask lives
  in the header; Messages-style founder chat where sharks' questions are
  one-tap suggestions; offer card with two big sliders and one plain sentence
- results: centered deal / counter / no-deal card
- reveal: one company at a time with progress dots, then a clean day summary
- portfolio: Stocks-style list with big total and friendly growth (e.g. 12x)
- offline founder answers in first person; facts reworded to read naturally

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add lifetime portfolio and simplify the whole UI for younger players

- portfolio screen: every finished day added up (invested, worth now, profit,
  winners vs losers, each company owned); local for guests, server when signed in
- plain-language copy everywhere: Meet / Watch / Ask / Invest steps, 'How much
  money will you invest?' / 'How much of the company do you want?', live sentence
  explaining what an offer means, clear deal/no-deal results
- 'Money words in 30 seconds' glossary on home; simpler founder dialogue
- reveal: 'Your $100K -> $0', plain status labels, lesson per company,
  profit-based scoreboard vs sharks, portfolio total
- home: one Play button, continue/resume, daily challenge, portfolio shortcut
- top bar: company progress + money left today; Home link elsewhere

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add 8 pitches (5 failures), balanced daily mix, $1M daily bankroll, portfolio API

- new: Kisstixx, TITIN, Zipz, You Smell Soap, ShowNo (failed); Go Oats (small);
  Bantam Bagels, Coffee Meets Bagel (wins). Kodiak value corrected to $200M+
- every day mixes 1-3 failed companies with survivors, shuffled
- each day starts with $1M; standings ranked by profit (return on money invested)
- GET /api/me/portfolio: all finished days and holdings for signed-in players
- game_runs.bankroll column; new 'deal_closing' lesson

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add v2: Supabase auth, saved runs, leaderboards, daily challenge

- Supabase project tank-day: profiles, pitches, game_runs, game_deals with RLS
  (scores writable only by the backend; outcomes service-role only)
- backend: JWKS (ES256) token verification, optional/required user deps,
  game ownership, claim guest games, run persistence, leaderboard + history APIs,
  SupabasePitchRepository + sync script, daily challenge seeded by UTC date
- frontend: magic-link sign-in, leaderboard (daily / all-time), daily button,
  saved-run status on reveal
- tests for daily determinism, save-once, claim and ownership (28 total)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add content scripts, README and content/copyright guide

- scripts/new_pitch.py, generate_shark_reactions.py (Claude structured output), trim_clip.sh
- README with setup, architecture and API
- docs/CONTENT_AND_COPYRIGHT.md: embed-only policy for official clips

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add React + Vite game UI, dev tooling and pitch validator

- views (Home, Game, Reveal) + components (sharks, founder chat, offer slip
  with live valuation meter, decision banner, reveal cards, leaderboard)
- zustand store with resumable guest games (localStorage game id)
- SSE streaming founder answers over POST
- Vite proxy for /api and /media; Makefile; .claude/launch.json
- scripts/validate_pitches.py content checks

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add FastAPI backend (MVC), game engine, founder logic and 9 pitches

- models / repositories / services / controllers layout
- deterministic founder accept/counter/walk logic with smart-money bonus
- reveal scoring with dilution, MOIC, shark standings, index-fund benchmark
- live AI founder (Claude Haiku, SSE) with offline fallback
- 9 pitches using official YouTube embeds with sourced real outcomes
- media route serves whitelisted files only (no outcome leaks)
- pytest suite (24 tests)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add MVP plan
